ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow Markov to use the camera for QR code scanning.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Markov connects to the desktop app on your LAN.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Markov to use your microphone for voice dictation sent to your paired desktop for transcription.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow Markov to save images from your sessions to Photos.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow Markov to attach photos from your library to a terminal session on your paired desktop.
